tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows hypoxemia, mild pancytopenia (low leukocytes, erythrocytes, hemoglobin, platelets), and abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia, neutropenia). Liver and kidney function are within normal limits, except for low ALT. No evidence of acute infection with SARS-CoV-2. Findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration; clinical correlation and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
